CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION metrics.CalculateRollupPath ( @rollupPathUid uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS nvarchar(max) AS BEGIN DECLARE @result nvarchar(max), @maxHop int = 1
select @maxHop = max(Position) from [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] where RollupPathUid = @rollupPathUid
select @result = string_agg(P.PathSegment, ' ') from ( select top 100 percent case L.EndPosition when @maxHop then Sa.Name + ' which is ' + lower(P.Inverse) + ' ' + Ea.Name else Sa.Name + ' which ' + lower(P.Name) end as PathSegment from [metrics].[RollupPathLink] L inner join [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] Ss on Ss.RollupPathUid = L.RollupPathUid and Ss.Position = L.StartPosition inner join AssetType Sa on Sa.ID = Ss.AssetTypeID inner join [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] Se on Se.RollupPathUid = L.RollupPathUid and Se.Position = L.EndPosition inner join AssetType Ea on Ea.ID = Se.AssetTypeID inner join IntersectType I on I.ID = L.IntersectTypeID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID where L.RollupPathUid = @rollupPathUid order by L.StartPosition ) P
if @result is null begin set @result = '{PATH NO LONGER VALID}' end
RETURN @result END
